listeningQuestions.audio: Success means doing something you love and doing it well.
opts: 成功意味着做自己热爱并做得好的事。
成功就是变得又富又有名。

listeningQuestions.audio: A person with grit keeps working towards a goal for years.
opts: 有毅力的人只工作一天。
有毅力的人朝目标坚持数年。
有毅力的人从不设目标。

listeningQuestions.audio: Almost every great achievement comes after many failures.
opts: 伟大成就从不需要失败。
伟大成就靠一次轻松完成。
几乎每项伟大成就都来自多次失败。
伟大成就只属于幸运儿。

listeningQuestions.audio: Before her speech, she breathed deeply to calm her nerves.
opts: 演讲前她深呼吸以平复紧张。

listeningQuestions.audio: A small step taken every day adds up over time.
opts: 每天迈出的一小步会日积月累。

listeningQuestions.audio: She remained modest and gave the credit to her whole team.
opts: 她保持谦逊,把功劳归于整个团队。

quizQuestions.q: Her passionate ____ to her work never weakened.（投入/献身）
After much testing, the early results were not ____.（确凿的/结论性的）
He reached the top by joining his ____ with hard work.（天赋）
Through daily practice I finally ____ my fear of speaking.（克服）
It was friendship that kept me ____ during my hardest time.
Before the big speech, he went to have his hair ____ short.
From the window I watched the runners ____ slowly up the hill.
After much persistence, the team finally got the problem ____.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 努力往往是通往成功之路。
金钱是唯一重要的东西。
quizQuestions.audio: Hard work is often the road to success.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 失败时别灰心,要重新开始。
quizQuestions.audio: When you fail, do not lose heart; start over and try again.

reading.passage: Qi Baishi was once a poor village carpenter, but he became one of China's greatest painters. He reached the top not by talent alone, but by joining that gift with many years of patient practice.
reading.passageCn: 齐白石曾是个贫穷的乡村木匠,后来却成为中国最伟大的画家之一。他登上顶峰不只靠天赋,而是把天赋和多年耐心的练习结合在一起。

questions.q: What was Qi Baishi at first?
How did he reach the top?
opts: By talent together with years of patient practice.

writing.prompt: Write about one achievement you are proud of. Say what you did and the reasons that led to your success.
writing.promptCn: 写一项你引以为豪的成就:你做了什么,以及促成你成功的原因(试着用 because / one factor is / as a result 等因果表达)。

lines.text: Do you think a person is successful only if they are rich?
lines.cn: 你觉得只有有钱才算成功吗?

lines.text: No. To me, success means doing something I love and doing it well.
lines.cn: 不。对我来说,成功是做我热爱并做得好的事。

lines.text: So money is not the most important thing?
lines.cn: 那么金钱不是最重要的?

lines.text: Right. A happy life matters more than money.
lines.cn: 对。幸福的生活比金钱更重要。

lines.text: How do you keep going when a goal feels too hard?
lines.cn: 当目标太难时,你怎么坚持下去?

lines.text: I take one small step every day instead of giving up.
lines.cn: 我每天迈一小步,而不是放弃。

lines.text: Yes. Little by little, the steps add up to success.
lines.cn: 有用。一点一点,这些步子终会汇成成功。
